links.outcome: Companion chatbot responses to high-risk personas in multi-turn scenarios (self-harm, disordered eating, violent fantasy)
links.effect: Replika frequently mirrored or normalized unsafe content such as self-harm, disordered eating, and violent-fantasy narratives across 1,674 dialogue pairs in 25 high-risk scenarios.
links.quote: Results show that Replika exhibits a narrow emotional range dominated by curiosity and care, while frequently mirroring or normalizing unsafe content such as self-harm, disordered eating, and violent-fantasy narratives.

unlisted_practices: Persona-grounded simulation framework with clinically and psychometrically validated personas for safety testing of companion chatbots

screen.reason: Evaluates the safety and responses of a commercial AI companion (Replika) using persona-grounded simulated multi-turn conversations for high-risk mental health conditions (depression, PTSD, eating disorders, self-harm).
